name: Butternut Squash Soup with Arugula, Cranberry & Pumpkin Seed Salad
ingredients: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Place butternut squash, broth, coconut milk, paprika, and salt in a large pot. Stir to combine the soup.
Bring the soup to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until squash is very soft, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Place in a medium bowl.
Add carrots, Parmesan, cranberries, and pumpkin seeds to the bowl with the arugula. Set aside.
When the soup is done, remove from the heat. Purée with an immersion or regular blender (return to the pan).
Add dressing to the bowl with the arugula and toss to combine the salad.
Divide soup between bowls and sprinkle with additional pumpkin seeds; serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
